These events occurred in '''2974 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*An assassination attempt on [[Grand Lord]] [[Varner Hilts]].<ref name="LTOSS1">[[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 1|''Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral'' 1]]</ref>
*The Lost Tribe discovers [[Eshkrene]], the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] southern polar landmass.<ref name="LTOSS1" />
*[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Remulus Dreypa]] is released from his [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|oubliette]] by [[Parlan Spinner]].<ref name="LTOSS2">[[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 2|''Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral'' 2]]</ref>
*Dreypa and Spinner lead a revolt against the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].<ref name="LTOSS3">[[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 3|''Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral'' 3]]</ref>
*Dreypa releases his [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]] from [[Sessal Spire]].<ref name="LTOSS3" />
*Siege of Tahv and the destruction of the Leviathans and Dreypa.<ref name="LTOSS5">[[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 5|''Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral'' 5]]</ref>
*[[Parlan Spinner]] becomes a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].<ref name="LTOSS5" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[John Jackson Miller]] indicates that the events of [[Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral|''Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith—Spiral'']] occurred approximately one year after the events of ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''.<ref name="Faraway-Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith – Spiral #1">{{Faraway|url=comics/swlosttribeofthesithspiral/swlosttribeofthesithspiral1.html|text=''Star Wars: Lost Tribe of the Sith &ndash; Spiral'' #1}}</ref>
